name: HSM Turtle
description: Runs the diagram as the behaviour of the turtle of turtlesim: checks it for the turtle, generates and builds the hsm_controller ROS 2 package and drives the turtle with it, tracing its path. Needs ROS 2 with turtlesim, turtle_driver, hsm_generator and hsm_tests, and the hsmd dispatcher.

parameters.label: ROS 2 setup script
parameters.description: The setup.bash providing turtlesim, turtle_driver, hsm_generator and hsm_tests; empty: the editor's environment

parameters.label: Workspace
parameters.description: The colcon workspace of the generated package

parameters.label: Trace folder
parameters.description: Where the run writes the path of the turtle, as CSV and SVG

parameters.label: Run duration, s
parameters.description: The run stops earlier when the controller ends; 0: until Cancel

parameters.label: Start X, m
parameters.description: The start position of the turtle; the world is 11.09 m across

parameters.label: Start Y, m
parameters.description: The start position of the turtle; the world is 11.09 m across

parameters.label: Start heading, rad
parameters.description: The start heading of the turtle

parameters.label: No simulator window
parameters.description: Run the simulator without its window

actions.label: Check for the turtle
actions.description: Check the diagram and what the turtle cannot do: the laser scan events, the pump, the points outside the world

actions.label: Generate the package...
actions.description: Write the hsm_controller package into the src directory of the workspace

actions.label: Run the turtle...
actions.description: Generate and build the package, then drive the turtle with it; the event timeline streams into the plugin's output tab, the path of the turtle is written into the trace folder
